name: tracker-native-sync-rehearsal
goal: Exercise native Tracker item operations through the signed hub and two spoke services with SQLite journals.

evidence: One in-process hub and two stores represent three independent database identities. Simulate a committed push with a lost receipt and edits during disconnection before reconnecting both spokes.
The previously declared journal, item transitions, signer, hub and spoke handlers compose using TrackerPersistenceService. The fixture starts no live listener or service.
8aad56ce8e passed 56 cases on harbor-mbp-2, including signed lost-receipt retry and convergence after concurrent notes and owner edits in three independent SQLite stores.
